description: A custom link in the footer of the business page.

business_uid.description: Unique identifier of the business that owns the link (e.g., "ea0tpkm5j3q86uaa").

business_page_uid.description: Unique identifier of the business page that shows the link (e.g., "k2xw9q4m7zt1h8ba").

text.description: Text of the link in the page footer (e.g., "Privacy policy").

url.description: Target of the link. Only http and https URLs are accepted (e.g., "https://example.com/privacy").

position.description: Zero-based place of the link in the footer. In an update, the link moves to this place and the server shifts the other links (e.g., 0, 1, 2).

created_at.description: Time when the link was created (e.g., "2026-11-13T10:30:00Z").

updated_at.description: Time of the last change. Send this value back in an update to detect a conflicting change (e.g., "2026-11-13T10:30:00Z").
